captions.detailed: A 3D-printable keychain featuring an extruded cylindrical stick with pixelated, 8-bit style text wrapped around it. At one end, there is a separate rotatable hanger piece with a rounded, spherical tip and a transverse hole for a keyring. The pixelated letters protrude from the main cylindrical body, creating a tactile, textured surface along the length of the keychain.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric 8-bit message keychain in OpenSCAD. The keychain should consist of a cylindrical stick with customizable 8-bit text extruded on its surface and a rotatable hanger attachment at one end with a keyring hole. Key parameters should include the message string, font size, font spacing, and tolerance.
captions.factory: The script imports an 8-bit polyfont library to generate custom text. It builds a main 'stick' module by intersecting a linear extrusion of the polygon-based 8-bit font with a cylinder, then unioning this with a slightly smaller core cylinder. A separate 'hanger' module is created using a cylinder and sphere, with a transverse cylinder subtracted for the keyring hole, and a socket subtracted using a scaled 'connecthead' module. The stick and hanger are assembled together using translation and rotation transforms with a defined tolerance.
